evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <fresh scratch dir>
evidence_tree.isolation_note: Only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, the diff and git history were never opened. No network fetch was used.

sources_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.

Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target towards the target location ... dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies once they land. Modifiers: values [70, 100, 130, 160, 190] (flat) + values [65, 65, 65, 65, 65] units '% AP'.
splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge, W 60-splinter true-damage (12%+2%/100 AP), P 120-splinter +15% AP buff
E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage)

sources_quoted.source: CLAUDE.md domain knowledge (restated in docs/math-foundations.md Section 2)
sources_quoted.quote: True damage ignores all resistances entirely.
Multi-hit abilities. A part with `h` identical hits is mitigated per hit and summed ... the mitigation operator `x -> x*100/(100+R)` is *linear in raw damage* for a fixed resistance.

independent_computation.step_0_scenario_decode: The scenario suffix '60' is the Splinters-of-Wrath count. 60 is exactly the Transcendent threshold at which Force of Will gains bonus TRUE damage (and is below the 80/100/120 thresholds, so no E bonus, no R execute, no +15% AP capstone). Total AP is therefore un-buffed.

step_1_recover_config_from_the_numbers.method: Solve for the (W rank, total AP) pair that reproduces 139.2 exactly from the sourced closed form, then cross-check the old value against the same AP.
step_1_recover_config_from_the_numbers.conclusion: Only W rank 5 with AP = 600 lands on a round configuration, and it reproduces 139.2 exactly (not approximately).
step_1_recover_config_from_the_numbers.independent_cross_check: At the same AP = 600, Syndra Q rank 5 = 230 + 0.70*600 = 650.0 -- exactly the OLD value. Both the old and the new leaf values are exact Syndra numbers at AP = 600 with max ranks, which independently confirms the recovered configuration.

step_2_compute_the_new_value.mitigation: None. True damage ignores all resistances, so the ledger value equals the raw value.

step_3_validate_the_reading_of_'12%_of_w.question: The prose '12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage' is elliptical about its base.
proof_it_is_12%_of_Force_of_Will's_magic: Constant terms of the cached 'Bonus True Damage' row are [8.4, 12, 15.6, 19.2, 22.8] = 0.12 * [70, 100, 130, 160, 190] = 12% of the W base magic damage at each rank. Exact for all five ranks.
The cached 'Total Mixed Damage' row is [78.4, 112, 145.6, 179.2, 212.8] = 1.12 * [70, 100, 130, 160, 190], i.e. magic + true with the same multiplicative reading.
step_3_validate_the_reading_of_'12%_of_w.conclusion: The multiplicative reading (12% + 2%/100AP applied to the W's pre-mitigation magic damage) is confirmed by two independent coefficient families across all five ranks.

step_4_what_the_old_value_is.finding: 650.0 is not any reading of the W true-damage term. It is exactly Syndra Q (Dark Sphere) rank 5 at AP 600: 230 + 0.70*600 = 650.0.
step_4_what_the_old_value_is.mitigation_check: 650.0 cannot be a mitigated form of 139.2 or vice versa: 650 -> 139.2 would require MR = 366.9, and 580 -> 139.2 would require MR = 316.6. Neither is a sane target resistance. The two values are different damage instances, not the same instance recomputed.
step_4_what_the_old_value_is.interpretation: At index 9 the pre-change ledger held a Dark Sphere event; the post-change ledger holds the Force of Will 60-splinter true-damage event. Consistent with the 60-splinter true-damage instance being newly emitted (or newly ordered) into the shared event ledger, shifting subsequent indices.

discrepancy_flagged.what: The cached 'Bonus True Damage' / 'Total Mixed Damage' rows carry a third modifier of 1.14 '% AP' (constant across ranks), which is the AP-squared coefficient.
discrepancy_flagged.derived_value: The correct AP^2 coefficient implied by the other two coefficient families is 0.02 * 0.65 / 100 = 0.00013, i.e. 1.3 in the wiki's per-100-AP '% AP' convention -- not 1.14.
discrepancy_flagged.consequence: Taking the cached 1.14 literally would give 22.8 + 0.116*600 + 0.0114*(600/100)*600 = 133.44 instead of 139.2.
discrepancy_flagged.resolution: The cached 1.14 is internally inconsistent with the same table's own constant terms (which pin 12%) and linear terms (which pin the 0.65 AP ratio), both of which match exactly at every rank. The prose formula plus the two self-consistent coefficient families win; 1.14 is a wiki/parser artifact. 139.2 is the value implied by the sourced formula.
discrepancy_flagged.note: This is a data-cache oddity worth a look on the next patch pull; it does not change the verdict.

caveats: The scenario definition itself lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/, tests/), so the exact cast order and the identity of ledger index 9 could not be read directly. The configuration (Syndra, W rank 5, total AP 600, 60 splinters) was recovered purely by solving the sourced closed forms against both the old and new leaf values, and both solve exactly at the same AP.
The target's magic resistance was not needed: the new value is true damage and is resistance-independent.
